name: Loni Kalbhor
notes: Independent Gram Panchayat (LGD local body code 185740, 'LONIKALBHOR'). Population/households cross-verified across census2011.co.in and villageinfo.org (both report 22,518 / 4,720). Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), which agrees with the basemap the GIS screen draws. They were previously taken from a Wikipedia infobox written to arcminute precision (18°29'N 74°02'E) — about 1.3 km out, and enough to open the map off the village.

name: Wagholi
notes: Census Town (CT). Population/households cross-verified (census2011.co.in subdistrict table and etrace.in both report 33,479 / matching household count). Officially merged into Pune Municipal Corporation in the June 2021 merger of 23 fringe villages (confirmed by Wikipedia and multiple news reports, and by PMC splitting Wagholi into election wards). The March-2022 LGD snapshot used here still lists an active local-body code (185785), which appears to be administrative lag rather than evidence the Gram Panchayat still functions -- treat Wagholi as NOT having an independent GP today.

name: Lonikand
notes: Independent Gram Panchayat (LGD local body 185741, 'LONIKAND'). Population/households from Wikipedia infobox, consistent with LGD listing as a standalone village.

name: Manjari Budruk
notes: Named explicitly ('Manjari Budruk') in the December 2020 draft notification and the June 2021 list of 23 villages merged into PMC (per Wikipedia). The March-2022 LGD snapshot still shows an active local body code (185746), the same lag pattern seen with Wagholi -- current GP status should be re-verified locally before use.

name: Manjari Khurd
notes: Not named in either the 2017 or 2021 PMC merger lists found; LGD shows active local body 185747 'MANJARI KH.'. Distinct from neighboring Manjari Budruk, which is on the 2021 merger list.

name: Theur

name: Uruli Kanchan
notes: Independent GP (LGD local body 185778, 'URULIKANCHAN'). Population/households corroborated by both Wikipedia and its LGD listing, but the underlying census figures both ultimately trace to the same Census 2011 PCA table (not fully independent sources).

name: Kesnand
notes: Independent GP (LGD local body 185726, 'KESNAND'). Population/households from a single secondary census aggregator (villageinfo.org).

name: Phursungi
notes: Merged into Pune Municipal Corporation in the July 2017 round of 11 villages (Wikipedia). LGD's March-2022 record for Phursungi/Fursungi (village code 556292) carries NO local-body code, i.e. no separate Gram Panchayat -- this is internally consistent with the merger. The population figure (66,062) is sourced from Wikipedia's current article text and its vintage/boundary is not certain to be the strict 2011 census village boundary given rapid post-merger growth; treat with caution and re-verify against the official Census 2011 Village Directory PDF if exact 2011 figures matter.

name: Undri
notes: Merged into PMC in the July 2017 round of 11 villages. LGD's March-2022 record shows NO local-body code, confirming no independent GP today.

name: Shewalwadi
